products.title: Snow Day Penguin Christmas Phone Case for iPhone, Samsung & Pixel | Tough Case
products.description:
Penguin on Ice Skates
A little penguin on old-fashioned white ice skates, in a cherry-red bobble hat and a red and white striped scarf, stands above “Snow Day” in rounded navy letters, on icy powder-blue wrapping paper with tiny snowflakes and silver dots.

Part of the Christmas Hearthside collection: ten cases, each a small lit window on a winter evening, with one warm subject on quietly patterned wrapping paper. The paper texture and glow are part of the printed artwork; the case itself has a smooth finish. A polycarbonate shell over a TPU lining resists daily impacts, and clear, open ports keep charging easy. Made for iPhone, Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel, in glossy or matte.

Product features
- Dual-layer case: 100% polycarbonate shell, 100% TPU lining
- Glossy or matte finish
- Clear, open ports for charging and connectivity
- Supports wireless charging (not MagSafe compatible)
- Blank case sourced from South Korea

Care instructions
- Clean with a soft, damp cotton or microfiber cloth. Avoid chemicals.

featured_image.alt: Snow Day Penguin Christmas Phone Case for iPhone, Samsung & Pixel | Tough Case
